notes: Shopify storefront (ikiru.in, www redirects 301 to non-www). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (generic 'Allow: /' for User-agent: *), so HTTP-fetch tier was used throughout: robots.txt, sitemap_collections_1.xml (953 collection URLs) and the 8 sitemap_products_*.xml files (total catalog = 7435 live products, confirmed both by summing sitemap <loc> counts and by a collection page ('Diwali Festive Sale') that itself displays 7435 products = 100% of catalog). Homepage mega-nav (150+ /collections/ links) was also pulled to check which candidate collections are current live taxonomy vs orphaned campaign pages. Every candidate holiday-named collection slug found in the sitemap (diwali/christmas/rakhi/valentine/mother's-day/new-year/holi/onam/women's-day, ~50 slugs total) was queried via its Shopify /collections/<slug>/products.json endpoint (paginated, real product ids deduped) to get an exact, non-inflated product count, and product titles were sampled (up to the full list for ambiguous ones) to content-verify genuine holiday association rather than trusting the URL/title alone, per the Mother's-Day-trap warning. A nonsense slug (https://ikiru.in/collections/asdkfjasdlkfj-nonsense-slug-2026) returned a real 404, confirming these are genuine Shopify collections, not auto-generated alias pages. Page-displayed 'N products' counts were cross-checked against the products.json enumeration for every included row and matched exactly (no cap/inflation). No Halloween, Thanksgiving, Eid, or Father's Day collection exists anywhere in the sitemap. DIWALI (given special attention as required): 3 genuine, currently-stocked Diwali collections found and included below (diwali-decoration, diwali-gifting-ideas, limited-festive-addition-diwali) -- all sampled and confirmed to be dominated by diya/urli/tealight/pooja-thali/dhoop-daan style Diwali decor items, explicitly labeled 'for Diwali'/'for Pooja'/'Diwali Set' in many titles. Other Diwali-named slugs were excluded: diwali-collection, diwali-home-decor-utsav, and 'the-grand-sajawat-by-ikiru-diwali...' all return 0 products (empty/retired campaign pages); diwali-festive-sale returns 5000+ (in fact literally 7435 = 100% of the entire catalog on its own product-count display) -- a storewide sale page mislabeled with 'Diwali', excluded per the sale-page rule and the oversized-fraction red flag. CHRISTMAS: christmas-decoration-items (=identical product set to the alias URL christmas-decor-item-2025, confirmed by id-set intersection -- only counted once, using the nav-linked canonical URL) is the one live Christmas category actually present in the site's main navigation, titled 'Christmas Decorations - Festive Joy for Every Home'; sampled products are a mix of Christmas ornaments/mugs/wreaths explicitly labeled Christmas plus general table/serveware -- included as the site's own designated Christmas merchandising collection (well under the 20-30% catalog-fraction flag at 3%). A second, NOT-nav-linked 'christmas-decor' collection (192 products, title emphasizes 'Upto 30% OFF') was excluded as a likely superseded/duplicate sale campaign with a lower ratio of genuinely Christmas-labeled items. The three Christmas 'gifts under <price>' tiers (1499/2999/4999) were sampled and found to be near-entirely generic tableware/cushion/lamp gift assortments with only 1-2 Christmas-worded items per ~20 sampled -- excluded as generic price-tier gifting reused under a Christmas label (same pattern as the Mother's Day trap). RAKSHA BANDHAN: rakhi-special-2026 (102 products) sampled and confirmed genuinely Rakhi-specific (rakhi gift hampers, rakhi box with Ganesha idol, 'Bhai Blessings' hamper) -- included. Older/adjacent rakhi slugs (festive-rakhi-2023, gifting-rakhi-edition, rakhi-gifting-under-1999, rakhi-gifting-under-3999) were sampled and found generic (platters, wine racks, table clocks with no rakhi-specific wording) or stale-dated -- excluded. VALENTINE'S DAY: handpicked-valentines-day-gifts (29 products) sampled in full and confirmed genuinely themed (red/heart/'sweetheart' scented candles, red-and-white heart mugs) -- included. The larger 'valentine-day' collection (85 products, sampled in full) turned out to be entirely generic bar/drinkware/tableware (whiskey glasses, ice buckets, cocktail shakers, dinner sets) with zero Valentine-referencing product titles -- excluded as a mislabeled generic catalog, exactly the failure pattern flagged in the task brief. drinkware-valentines-edition and date-decor-valentines-edition were likewise sampled and found fully generic (barware / planters+dried-flowers with no valentine theming) -- excluded. MOTHER'S DAY (in-scope per rules, content-verified per rules): the-mothers-day-edit (493 products, ~7% of catalog) was sampled and found to be plain generic home decor (tea box, table clock, candle, nesting tables, spice jars) with no Mother's-Day-specific products -- excluded, matching the documented prior-batch failure mode exactly. motherlux (5 products) sampled and also fully generic (serving bowl, vase, storage box, candle stand, spice jar) with no clear Mother's Day tie -- excluded. FATHER'S DAY: no collection of any name found in the sitemap -- absent. NEW YEAR: new-year-sale returns 0 products -- excluded (empty). HOLI: holi-refresh-edit returns 0 products -- excluded (empty; no other Holi-named collection exists). Also checked and excluded as out-of-scope/generic: onam-edit-2025 (0 products, Onam not in the in-scope holiday list anyway), womens-day-gifting (Women's Day not in scope), mix-pooja-essential-festive (43 products, genuine pooja/religious items but not tied to one named holiday -- generic 'festive' pooja essentials), eco-friendly-festive-gifting (27, generic eco gift assortment), festive-collection/festive-edition/festive-offer/festive-pooja-edition/pre-festive-sale (all 0 products), festive-livingroom (2) and festive-outdoors (1) (negligible, generic), new-festive-launches (516, generic new-arrivals mislabeled 'festive'), celebrate-with-upto-40-off (494, storewide sale). Product-type nav category 'diya-diya-stand' exists but is a generic product-type page (not holiday-named by the site), so left out per the boundary rule against counting a category that merely contains seasonal products.
